# Control Flow

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ControlFlow`](gmeow-ControlFlow.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ControlFlow>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

A reified relator that connects two ProcedureSteps in a control-flow relationship — sequencing, branching, or looping. Reuses the [`Participation`](gmeow-Participation.md) idiom: mediates a source step, a target step, and an optional guard condition ([`gmeow:flowGuard`](../properties/gmeow-flowGuard.md)). The actual guard evaluation is solver-side ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ControlFlow`](gmeow-ControlFlow.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
